description: This file defines the 'ThingRevision' interface, representing the concept of a revision of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes a method for creating new immutable instances of ThingRevision with a specified revision number.

classes.name: ThingRevision
classes.description: An interface representing a revision of a 'Thing' in the Ditto model. It extends a generic Revision interface and provides a static method for creating new instances.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable instance of ThingRevision with the specified revision number, delegating to the ThingsModelFactory.
